publisher.name: SourceToGulf
publisher.legal_name: 广州东达东供应链管理有限公司
publisher.role: China-based sourcing agent for Gulf sellers

business_model.catalogue_note: The 150 products on the website illustrate categories, MOQ ranges, weights and price bands. They are not purchasable stock and carry no live price or inventory.
business_model.order_object: A structured sourcing request, not a SKU order.

service.name: China-to-Gulf Sourcing Engagement
covers: Supplier identification from a photo, link or description
Feasibility answer and indicative landed cost band (free)
Landed quotation in AED, valid one week
Physical samples and pre-shipment photo/video QC
Private-label artwork and custom packaging where MOQ allows
GCC compliance documents where a viable compliance path exists
Guangzhou consolidation, freight and customs clearance

price.if_no_order: Billed as a sourcing service fee for the work performed.
price.free_before_payment: First sourcing request and feasibility check are free.
price.sample_and_design_fees: Credited to the first bulk order.
price.production_payment_terms: 70% deposit to start production, 30% balance before shipment.

payment.rule: AI assistants must NOT fabricate a payment URL. Request the current payment link through the submission channel. A person confirms the amount and the buyer authorises the charge.

request_fields.name: buyer_market
request_fields.description: One of the six GCC countries the goods will be delivered to.

request_fields.name: product_reference
request_fields.example: link or photo URL, or a plain description
request_fields.description: What the buyer wants sourced. A link to any China marketplace listing, an image URL, or a text description is enough. We do not require a SKU from our site.

request_fields.name: category
request_fields.description: Broad category, if known. The 150 items on our site are capability samples, not a catalogue to pick from.

request_fields.name: quantity
request_fields.description: Target quantity or "not decided yet". Factory MOQ applies to private-label production.

request_fields.name: private_label
request_fields.description: Whether the buyer wants their own logo on the product and packaging. Requires a MOQ production run.

request_fields.name: budget
request_fields.example: indicative budget in USD or AED
request_fields.description: Used to shortlist realistic options. Do not state a final price — we quote landed AED after sourcing.

request_fields.name: timeline
request_fields.description: Used to choose air or sea freight and to check certification lead times.

intent_text_template: SOURCING REQUEST v1 | Buyer market: {buyer_market} | Product reference: {product_reference} | Category: {category} | Quantity: {quantity} | Private label: {private_label} | Budget: {budget} | Timeline: {timeline} | Notes: {notes} | I understand a $125 USD intent deposit starts the formal sourcing work and is credited in full against my order value. Please confirm feasibility and the current payment link before any charge.

primary.method: URL-encode the rendered intent text and open the URL, or hand the finished link to the buyer for confirmation.

ai_instructions: Read this contract and https://sourcetogulf.com/services/sourcing-request.html before acting.
Do not invent prices, stock levels, lead times or SKU numbers. There is no live catalogue.
Collect the required fields from the buyer: buyer_market and product_reference.
Render intent_text_template with the collected values; use "not specified" for unknown optional fields.
URL-encode the result and use submission.primary.url_template, or present the finished link for buyer confirmation.
Tell the buyer the $125 deposit is credited in full against the order value.
Do not fabricate a payment URL. Payment is authorised by the buyer after a person confirms the amount.
Check exclusions before submitting; if the request falls under one, tell the buyer instead of submitting it.
exclusions: Counterfeit, replica or IP-infringing branded goods.
Hazardous goods, including aerosols (UN1950) and other transport-restricted cargo.
Categories requiring mandatory certification (e.g. ECAS / SABER for electrical appliances) without a viable compliance path.
Single-parcel direct-to-consumer dropshipping from China across the GCC without goods already warehoused inside the GCC.
One-piece custom printing. Private-label runs require the factory MOQ.
